---
title: "About"
---

I am an Associate Professor in the Department of
Artificial Intelligence and Data Engineering at Istanbul Technical University.
I work on artificial neural networks, (bio)medical image analysis, computer
vision, and industrial AI applications.

Before ITU I was at Işık University, Department of Computer Engineering, 
with earlier positions at the Heidelberg
Collaboratory for Image Processing, MedicSight PLC in London, the University of
Westminster, and TÜBİTAK-BİLTEN (Now Space Technologies Inst.). 
My PhD, on computerised diagnosis of malaria, is from the University of Westminster.

The longer version is on the [CV page](cv.qmd).
